technical.summary: CBRE shows mixed intermediate-term bullish structure (price above key EMAs, supertrend, Ichimoku) but lacks momentum confirmation (RSI not rising, OBV weak) and faces long-term headwinds (EMA 50/200 bearish, SMA 200 below price); moderate risk/reward for swing entry with elevated overbought conditions.
